The person presses a trembling hand to their bleeding arm—suddenly, the wound blossoms with intricate chrome petals, unfolding like precision-engineered origami. Tiny gears and pistons emerge from the flesh, clicking into place as they assemble into a mesmerizing clockwork rose, its metallic petals whirring with mechanical life. Drops of blood transform into liquid mercury, shimmering as they fall and splatter into hypnotic fractal patterns across the floor, each ripple forming geometric mandalas. The camera circles the scene, capturing the surreal fusion of organic injury and biomechanical growth, illuminated by cold, clinical lighting that casts sharp reflections off the metallic surfaces. Dust motes swirl in the air, catching the glint of moving gears, while the faint hum of machinery underscores the uncanny transformation.
